pydev eclipse we are trying to debug a server that forks processes to serve user requests the problem is that there are often more forks in short period of time and frequently pydev debugger gets into a wrong state and is not able to communicate with these children more details from jojo it relates to the os fork calls during startup that happen in rapid succession our code spawns workers during its startup but the mainthread for both processes ends up under a single unknown node in the pydev debugger a very small percentage of the time i am still able to step despite this so it seems to be a race condition when i configure our code to spawn only worker pydev works very well so that s my work around even then our code still spawns other child processes when handling requests but it isn t rapid fire spawning and each mainthread is paired one to one with an unknown as long as that is the case pydev stepping seems to work well in the pydev logs this is what happens during yt startup with workers received command t t found a new thread sending cmd t t xml thread name mainthread id xml n found a new thread sending cmd t t xml thread name mainthread id xml n that s one mainthread for each of the two workers but notice that the two sending cmd have the same sequence number and because this is during startup the mainthread also have the same id despite being in separate processes

hi pythonic delete backspace indent of selected lines tab and dedent of selected or unselected lines shift tab can sometimes cause code to become out of sync with the legal indent levels which can sometimes be annoying example def func print moo print cow place cursor directly before p in print press space by mistake press backspace you will now be out of sync with the indent level this can also happen when copying code from poorly formatted sources like web pages suggested resolution i suggest that pythonic backspace indent of multiple selected lines tab and dedent of selected or unselected lines shift tab should all position the code at the closest multiple of len static indent str spaces if several lines of code are selected i suggest that the indent level for the least indented line in the selection be used for line indent see code suggestion below i suggest that the behavior of indentation of single unselected lines be kept eg deduce indentation depending on the preceeding line i also suggest that the indent behavior in multiline string literals be kept eg indent dedent by static indent str code suggestion in python static indent str def indent len line indent i len static indent str return i line indent i def dedent len line indent if line indent return i line indent len static indent str return i or len static indent str test code def print outcome line indent print current line indent print dedent dedent len line indent print indent indent len line indent for i in range print outcome i thanks for a superb ide btw cheers joel

from brackets page quick edit one of the goals of brackets is to make it easy to make quick edits to different bits of code without having to jump around between files currently brackets has an early implementation of this if you re in an html file and you put the cursor inside a class or id attribute or a tag name you can hit ctrl cmd e for edit brackets will search the css files in the file tree for relevant rules then open up an inline editor embedded in the html file that lets you make quick tweaks to one of the rules on the right side of the inline editor brackets shows the list of all rules that might be relevant to the selected tag class id you can switch between the rules by clicking on them in the list or using alt up down arrow you can make changes in the inline editor and save them then close the editor by hitting cmd e again edits you make in the inline editor will be properly applied in live development mode see below some things to note about this feature brackets doesn t take the cascade tag context etc into account brackets doesn t check to see which css files are linked into the current html file it searches all files in the file tree eventually brackets could leverage inline editing for lots of other kinds of things in addition to showing relevant js code you could imagine adding inline visual tools like gradient and shadow editors for the selected css rule

in the type system functions derive from object as a result new properties can be added to function instances functions also my be invoked taking a possibly empty list of arguments and possibly returning a value the type system keeps track of these two bits of information in separate locations if properties are added to the function then a new sub type of function is created however parameters and return values are captured on the property that references the function type this makes for some difficulties in the current inferencing engine as we infer types for nodes in an ast we need to be able to determine return types of invoked functions we do this using a function signature function typename paramtypelist returntypelist typename represents the name of the function subtype it is wrapped in function so we know this type is a function invokable without having to traverse its ancestor hierarchy paramtypelist is a list of types one for each parameter note that a single parameter may have a collection of types this information is used for inferencing inside of the function s scope only returntypelist is a list of types that are returned by the function when it is invoked these types are used by the inferencing engine when it processes invocations when we ask for the type of a property we return a list of types as a list of strings when asking for the type of a function property specifically we need to return a function signature this notion was confused and the function typename aspect of the signature was used as the type name as well we really only need typename paramtypelist returntypelist using function typename makes it difficult to look up typename since you have no idea when to use just typename versus function typename for example the jquery library is defined by an sdocml file its constructors return a jquery type however internally we say that the jquery global method is of type function jquery so any time we see the type jquery we have to map it to function jquery by removing the notion of function from function types we should be able to avoid this hack and a few others the challenge of this change comes from refactoring the code to no longer rely on the function notation if a function is being accessed like an object then treating the function like any other object will be just fine for example in the following if you place the cursor at and ask for content assist then inferencing will look up abc s type and find that it is abc string at this point inferencing simply queries the index for abc and then displays all properties on that type in the proposal list however if you change the code slightly things get a little more challenging abc is actually a get property node with abc on its left hand side this is further defined as an invoke node with an identifier node as a child the child of an invoke node can be an arbitrary expression so we can t rely on that child always being an identifier this means that we have to infer the type of the child of the invoke node in this case we get abc which is type abc we re now at the line between types and properties we access the abc type but for purposes of invocation we need the abc property off of window in this case because that property tells us that it is a function that returns string it s type information doesn t tell us this and this is were the challenge lies the invocation node actually needs to infer what is called a reference a reference is a tuple composed of an object and a property name inferencing has been setup to return type info as strings so the fact that we need a reference here breaks our inferencing code around function invocation remember that the child of jsinvokenode has to be inferred this could be an arbitrarily complex subtree that touches most of the current cases handled by the inferencing engine the engine uses strings which implies we would have to build a parallel system to return a reference instead that would be a horrible maintenance pain in the neck so this is why inferencing uses function signatures these can be returned as strings and it preserves the return type info of the function all without having to use references and a parallel system for those so in theory we should be able to simply remove function from the type name and then anywhere in inferencing where we need to differentiate between a function or a property we can look up the ancestor chain of the type to determine if it derives from function ideally this could be cached in some way so we don t have to hit the index tons of times during inferencing even though we have a utility method to get a full ancestor chain of a type this requires one read per ancestor type for performance reasons we should always minimize reads writes to the index if possible
